name: The Old Market wholesale-and-retail ledger exhibit
subject: projects
brief: Your commerce group of three is assembling an exhibition board comparing wholesale vegetable invoices and retail stall tallies from Nabapara Old Market. You are the treasurer balancing the exhibit's accounts, and the commerce room is loud with three other groups rehearsing their talks across the aisle.

tasks.name: Copy and foot the dawn auction invoice column
Draw the evening retail basket-price bar chart

facts.text: Section A has booked the same display easel and table in the hall for the third period
Mira has a brass-edged accounting ruler for red double-underlines

note: Uses Nabapara Old Market (loc_old_market) and Mira Sen (npc_mira_sen) from INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md. The constraint is an easel and table booking clash known to Nasrin; the seam is that the wholesale column uses maunds and forty-kilogram sacks while the retail chart uses kilograms.
